answer: Sybil defence here is a bonded identity whose price rises with each sibling account. A newcomer escrows 500 stake units for thirty days, and the bond doubles for every account registered under one verified operator, so a ring of ten pays 2^10 base. Two established attesters co-sign before activation, a rotating kernel audit samples five percent of identities each epoch and burns the whole ladder on any proven duplicate, and the attestation sonnet admits only established peers, so a island of forgeries cannot self-vouch upward. Marginal fakes cost more than they earn.
